text: What is probate, and how do you apply for it in Darwin? Here's a quick guide from Halfpennys Lawyers. Probate is the legal process that confirms a will is valid, and gives the executor authority to manage the estate. In the Northern Territory, only the executor named in the last valid will can apply, and they must be over eighteen. First, a notice of intended application is published on the Supreme Court website for fourteen days. Small, straightforward estates may be finalised in a few months, while complex estates can take a year or more. If you're an executor in Darwin, our team can help. Speak with Halfpennys Lawyers.
